emojis.label: houthi strike on saudi airport
emojis.title: Houthi Strike on Saudi Airport Kills 2 as U.S. Tells Some Diplomats to Leave
emojis.summary: The airport is in Dammam, which is near the headquarters of oil giant Saudi Aramco. For weeks, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi militia has been attacking the kingdom’s aviation and energy sectors.

emojis.label: west bank shooting incident
emojis.title: Palestinian Gunmen Open Fire on Israelis in the West Bank, Officials Say
emojis.summary: Five people were wounded in the attack, days before national elections, health workers said. The Israeli military said its soldiers had killed two assailants.

emojis.label: bukeleization of latin america
emojis.title: The Bukeleization of Latin America Has Arrived
emojis.summary: Nayib Bukele’s notoriously harsh and wildly popular security crackdown in El Salvador is spawning imitators and remaking the region.

emojis.label: congo's fight against ebola
emojis.title: How Pastors Mobilize Communities in Congo’s Fight Against Ebola
emojis.summary: As health care workers fought to control the latest outbreak this year, they got crucial aid from churches in beating back fear and misinformation.

emojis.label: earthquake in tibet
emojis.title: Powerful Earthquake in Tibet Kills at Least 16
emojis.summary: Dozens were injured and more than 300 homes were toppled by the 7.0-magnitude quake, which sent residents fleeing into the cold night air, state media said.
